summary: Full e2e test of Grand Aceh Kuliner POS V1 (backend + frontend). Backend: 67/67 pytest cases pass (auth/RBAC, categories, products, tables+open-bill protections, order rules F&B vs retail, pay/discount, void/refund+audit+stock restore, shifts, reports, Excel template/export/import preview+commit+logs, and all 3 Gemini AI endpoints incl. Nano Banana image). Frontend: all POS flows verified live (take-away pay w/ 10% discount + receipt, dine-in open bill save->reload->append->pay, retail pay + stock decrement in UI), admin CRUD (Products w/ AI description + AI image, Categories, Tables incl. duplicate-name toast, Users, Orders void/refund, Dashboard report cards + AI summary, Shift open/sale/close report), Excel template/export downloads, import preview with per-row errors + commit. Kasir role gating verified (nav restricted, direct /products URL redirected to /pos). NO blocking defects. However, adversarial API probing exposed 5 real server-side validation gaps (price tampering, order-type spoofing, oversell, underpayment, negative discount) that the UI hides but any client can exploit.

critical.issue: Item price/name/type are trusted from the client and never re-validated against the products collection. Sending {product_id: <real retail product>, price: 1} creates a paid order of Rp1 for a Rp5.000 item (verified). Prices must be looked up server-side from db.products.

The F&B-vs-retail separation rule only inspects the client-supplied item.type. A retail product sent with type='makanan' was accepted into a dine_in order (verified 200), fully bypassing the core business rule. Resolve type from DB per product_id.
No stock validation: selling qty greater than stock succeeded and drove retail stock to -500 (verified). Reject or clamp when qty > stock for track_stock products.
Underpayment accepted: amount_paid=1 on a Rp5.000 total returned status 'paid' with change=-4999 (verified). Backend must reject amount_paid < total for cash.

discount_value is unbounded: discount_type='percent' with value -100 produced discount=-45000 and total=90000 (2x subtotal, verified). Also percent>100 is unchecked. Validate discount_value >= 0 (and <= 100 for percent) in Pydantic.
OrderItem.qty accepts negative values (qty=-5 accepted, verified) which yields negative subtotals and would inflate stock on void. Use Field(gt=0) for qty and ge=0 for price.

minor.issue: _shift_report derives expected_cash from by_payment['Cash'] i.e. the payment-method NAME string. Renaming the Cash method (admin can create methods freely) silently breaks expected_cash. Key off payment method type=='cash' instead.

Date filtering uses lexicographic string comparison on created_at ISO strings and only covers the UTC day. WIB (UTC+7) sales after 17:00 local fall into the next report day - shift/daily reports will be off for a real Aceh store. Store a real datetime or add a timezone offset.
Take-away/retail orders that are created but not paid stay status='open' forever with no UI to resume or cancel them (only admin void). Consider not persisting until payment, or add a cancel path.
No rate limiting / lockout: 8 consecutive wrong passwords all returned 401 and the 9th correct login succeeded (verified). Add lockout or throttling.
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to the lifespan context manager.

ui_bugs.issue: React console error on every load: "Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Login)" - a navigate()/setState call happens during render. Use <Navigate to=... /> or useEffect.
The floating 'AI' badge button sits on top of the Deskripsi textarea and covers the generated text's last line (see screenshot 30_product_ai). Move it above the textarea or add bottom padding.
Console warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' on every dialog (Pay, Table picker, Import, forms) - a11y gap.

integration_issues.issue: No visible success toast/summary was rendered after a successful commit (created/updated counts come back from the API but the toast list was empty when checked ~4s later). Confirm the success toast fires and consider showing created/updated counts inline.

issues: Fixed widths (sidebar 240 + category rail 200 + cart 340 = 780px) exceed the 768px viewport, so the product grid collapses to zero width and the cart is clipped off-screen - POS is unusable in portrait. App is landscape-first per spec, but add a min-width guard/collapsible rail or an 'rotate device' notice.
Uses the native browser <input type="date"> picker (renders as 08/19/2026 with the OS icon) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover used elsewhere - inconsistent with the design system.
All seeded products have no image, so every card shows the same grey placeholder icon; the grid reads as empty at a glance. Seed a few images (the AI image generator works and persists correctly).
Large empty area under the form on 1920x1080; the right panel content is vertically un-centred relative to the hero panel.

action_items: CRITICAL: recompute order item price/name/type server-side from db.products in POST /api/orders and PATCH /api/orders/{id}/items - client-supplied price and type are currently trusted (price tampering + F&B/retail rule bypass both reproduced).
Add stock validation for track_stock products before finalizing payment (stock went to -500).
Reject amount_paid < total for cash payments (order was marked paid with change=-4999).
Constrain discount_value (>=0, and <=100 for percent) and qty (>0) / price (>=0) in Pydantic models.
Key shift expected_cash off payment_method type=='cash' rather than the literal name 'Cash'.
Handle timezone: reports/shifts bucket by UTC day, which splits an Aceh (UTC+7) business day.
Fix the Login.jsx setState-during-render React error.
POS layout breaks at 768px portrait - add a min-width guard or collapsible rails.
Replace native date inputs on Dashboard/Transaksi with the shadcn Calendar component.
Optional: split server.py (840 lines) into routers (auth, catalog, orders, reports, excel, ai).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:_validate_order_rules trusts item.type from the request body; the entire hybrid F&B/retail separation guarantee is client-side only. Load each product by product_id and use its stored type + price.
server.py:_finalize_payment decrements stock without any availability check and computes change without verifying amount_paid >= total.
server.py:compute_totals has no guard on discount_value sign/upper bound, so a negative percent discount increases the total above subtotal.
server.py:_shift_report hardcodes by_pm.get('Cash') for expected_cash - fragile because payment method names are user-editable.
server.py is 840 lines (>700 guideline); AI, Excel and order domains should move into separate routers.
Auth stores the JWT in localStorage with no httpOnly cookie and no login throttling; CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' (acceptable only because allow_credentials=False). Consider explicit origins.
Deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown hooks should move to FastAPI lifespan.

success_rate.backend: 100% (67/67 pytest cases; separate adversarial probing found 6 validation gaps not covered by happy-path tests)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows passed (POS x3 order types, open bill, discount, receipt, admin CRUD x5 pages, AI x3, Excel import/export, shift, role gating)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -q` (67 cases, ~45s incl. AI) then ALWAYS run `python /app/backend/tests/cleanup_test_data.py` afterwards - it purges TEST_* entities plus all orders/shifts/logs and restores seeded stock. Do NOT make the cleanup a session-scoped autouse fixture: pytest.ini forces xdist -n 2, so a per-worker session teardown deletes TEST_* data while the other worker is still using it (this caused 2 false failures on the first run). Excel-import rows must use a category whose type matches tipe_produk (e.g. retail rows -> 'Snack Retail'/'Minuman Kemasan'); 'Cemilan' is makanan. UI: switching order-type tabs with a non-empty cart triggers window.confirm, so register page.on('dialog', accept). All 3 Gemini AI endpoints were working (text ~5s, image ~20s). Verify the 6 backend validation gaps listed in backend_issues.critical after the main agent fixes them - reproduce with direct API calls, not the UI (the UI already blocks them).
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of all 6 critical/high backend findings is the same: the order pipeline treats the request body as the source of truth. OrderItem carries name/price/type from the client and the server persists them verbatim; _validate_order_rules inspects those client fields, and compute_totals/_finalize_payment apply no domain constraints (no stock check, no amount_paid >= total check, no discount/qty bounds). Reproduction: POST /api/orders {order_type:'dine_in', table_id:<empty table>, items:[{product_id:<retail product id>, price:1, qty:1, type:'makanan'}]} -> 200 with total Rp1; POST /api/orders {..., discount_type:'percent', discount_value:-100} -> total = 2x subtotal; pay with amount_paid=1 -> status 'paid', change -4999; qty > stock -> stock -500. Mitigation: in create_order/update_order_items, fetch each product by product_id (404/400 if missing or inactive/sold_out), rebuild each item from the DB document (name, price, type, track_stock), validate stock for track_stock items, and add Pydantic Field constraints for qty (>0), price (>=0) and discount_value (>=0, <=100 when percent); in _finalize_payment reject amount_paid < total for cash methods.
